prompt_text: I need new tires installed in Pleasanton. Which specific tire shops should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can give the best, specific places to call — and a short script — but first a couple quick questions so I tailor it:

1. What’s your vehicle (make/model/year) and the tire size (example: 225/45R17)?  
2. Any priorities: lowest price, longest tread life, performance, all‑season vs summer vs winter, same‑day install, or OEM/brand loyalty?  
3. Do you prefer a national chain, Costco (if you have membership), a dealership, or an independent local shop?

If you want suggestions now without those details, here are reliable options to call in/near Pleasanton and why each is worth contacting:

- Discount Tire (nearby locations in the Tri‑Valley area)
  - Why: Large inventory, competitive pricing, fast same‑day installs, good balance of price and service, nationwide warranty and easy online quotes.
- Firestone Complete Auto Care (Pleasanton / nearby)
  - Why: Professional installation, often runs promotions, offers wheel alignment and other service bundles, nationwide presence for warranty/service.
- Costco Tire Center (nearest Costco — membership required)
  - Why: Very competitive tire pricing and road‑hazard warranty for many brands; high value if you’re a member (but can have longer waits and appointment requirements).
- Pep Boys (area locations)
  - Why: Tire sales plus a full range of auto services (alignment, brakes) and frequent coupon deals; good option if you want repairs done at same visit.
- Local independent tire shop in Pleasanton (search for “Pleasanton tire shop” + read reviews)
  - Why: Often more flexible on price, personalized service, sometimes better for older cars or quick adjustments; good to call if you want to support a local business or need specialty tires.

What to ask when you call (use this script):
- “Hi — I need four [or two] tires for a [make/model/year], tire size [size]. Do you have these in stock? What’s the total price for the tires plus mounting, balancing, valve stems, and disposal?”
- “Do you charge extra for TPMS sensors or valve stems? Is alignment included or recommended after installation and how much is it?”
- “What warranty/road‑hazard coverage comes with the tires? How long for an appointment and how long will installation take?”
- “Do you offer price matching or current promotions/discount codes? Any rebates from the tire manufacturer right now?”

How to choose between the quotes
- Compare total out‑the‑door price (tires + mount/balance + taxes + fees + alignment if required).  
- Prefer shops that include mount/balance and new valve stems in the price or clearly list those fees.  
- If performance or safety matters, compare treadwear warranty, manufacturer warranties, and road‑hazard coverage.  
- Check recent online reviews for appointment punctuality and installation quality.

If you want, tell me your vehicle and tire size (or ZIP code) and I’ll compile 3–5 specific shop names and phone numbers near Pleasanton plus a recommendation for which to call first.
